event.last_assistant_message:
Fixed. The root cause was `playwright-core` getting pulled into Vite's dependency optimization via the sketchpad's `@playwright/test` import. Added these three packages to `optimizeDeps.exclude` in [vite.renderer.config.ts:74](compose/desktop/vite.renderer.config.ts#L74):

```
exclude: ["@semio-tech/compose-js", "@semio-tech/compose-sketchpad", "@compose/studio", "@playwright/test", "playwright", "playwright-core"]
```

This stops the infinite `chromium-bidi` resolution loop that was crashing Electron with `ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES`.
